title: Updating an Origination Appraisal: Loan-Update Pricing for In-Place Home Resale Appraisals
content:
**Loan-update pricing.** The appraisal charge on an In-Place Home Resale file under the Guaranteed Resale Program follows the open Home Purchase Financing loan from Hearthstone Home Finance on the home — a loan in active or delinquent status — whose origination appraisal the appraiser can update, measured in whole calendar months from the loan's funding date to the date the resale file was opened:

- a loan funded fewer than 24 months before is updated at the desk, so the charge is the flat 275.00 desktop update fee in place of the appraisal sum;
- a loan funded at least 24 but fewer than 60 months before is updated with a new inspection of the home, so the charge is the appraisal sum multiplied by 0.8;
- a home with no open Hearthstone loan, or one funded 60 months or more before, is appraised afresh and charged the appraisal sum itself.

The charge is rounded half up to the cent only at that final step. The *appraisal sum* is the package's appraisal fee together with the additions the appraisal carries for the home and its file, added together.

| Open Home Purchase Financing loan on the home | Whole months from funding to the file's opening date | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| yes | fewer than 24 | 275.00 |
| yes | 24 to 59 | appraisal sum multiplied by 0.8 |
| yes | 60 or more | appraisal sum |
| no (none, or paid off) | not applicable | appraisal sum |

## Worked figures (hypothetical file opened on 15 March 2026, appraisal sum 695.00)

| Loan funded on | Whole months | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| 16 March 2024 | 23 | 275.00 |
| 15 March 2024 | 24 | 695.00 multiplied by 0.8, 556.00 |
| 15 March 2021 | 60 | 695.00 |
| no open loan | not applicable | 695.00 |
